test_send_recv: test the crypten communicator send and recv methods for point-to-point tensor communication between ranks
test_all_reduce: test the crypten communicator all_reduce method to sum tensors across all distributed ranks
test_broadcast_obj: test the crypten communicator broadcast_obj method to safely broadcast Python objects including nn.Module across ranks
test_gather_all_gather: test the crypten communicator gather and all_gather methods for collecting tensors from all ranks
test_communication_stats: test the crypten communicator communication stats tracking including rounds, bytes, and time metrics
